decisions.reason: As a peripheral but likely low-cost ecosystem option, the accelerator is still worth retaining for partnership and innovation-scanning value, though after two years it remains the most likely candidate for pruning if attention shifts back to core machinery and recycling projects.

The infectious waste decontamination plant is close to the firm's technology base and strategic direction, and in capital-equipment markets a further year is justified because commercial uncertainty is not yet fully resolved.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the firm's core modular, decentralized recycling offer especially well, so management would keep this option open unless clear market disappointment emerges.
